### Notes:
Need to build Disney+ benchmarks since we only got the TLAMP consent letter signed on 2/9  -This data shows install lift for each March roadblock.  -The 3/16 roadblock was Taylor Swift which saw insane performance across all markets, whereas the March 31 was the 12 hour bundle creative. - We have our control and exposed audiences for each roadblock and you can see that these roadblocks did generated triple digit lifts!  - The 3/16 roadblock had a higher install rate, but the 12 hour roadblock did drive stronger incremental lift.  Overall, these two roadblocks delivered 3.2M impressions to Not Installed, achieved 50K installs from not installed, and generated an 84 cent CPI. -

### Notes:
So here we have our two CPA funnels… The left shows paid media and just those roadblocks, whereas the right is just added value ROS lines. The way this works is we start with impressions. For example, the roadblock delivered 146M impressions. Of those impressions, 201K installs occurred. Of those who installed, 30K launched Disney+ for at least 1 30 minutes or more session. We back that acquisition number into your TOTAL spend to get the CPA. This does inflate the CPA since the roadblocks are untargeted. We are reaching those with Disney+, lapsed, active.. Everyone!  With enhanced reporting I did want to call out that the CPA range per roadblock was about $7-$12 which is fabulous. We also have  TLAMP  now which helps us get a bit closer to the most accurate cost here. Otherwise, I did want to shift our focus here to ROS. It achieved a $7.29 CPA which is wonderful given subscription fees and your customer lifetime value.  There is DEFINITELY opportunity to leverage ROS in the future. CPA prior was $27.29 with the 5 minute window instead of the 30 minutes Roadblocks this half alone generated more than 21,000 installs vs last half.  -what is your goal CPA?
